notes.title: Big Bad July 15th Update
notes.content:
Woah, hey gang! Welcome to Teatime Samurai July 15th update. What can you expect in this big ol' update?

[h2]Randomized Boss Order[/h2]
The order in which bosses appear is now totally randomized, so you're no longer fighting Liu and Shovel first every single game.

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
There are now multiple varieties of torches in Teatime Samurai. Each one has unique properties and behavior, and there are more on the way!

[h2]A New Boss Fight![/h2]
A stretchy yokai joins the boss lineup! Defeat the deadly dreamer in this new update!

[h2]Localization[/h2]
Teatime Samurai is now in a whole handful of languages! Tell your pen pals in far away places!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Tons of bug fixes, minor and major. Thank you for all the feedback!

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]
New enemies, weapons, and stats are on the way! Stay tuned for a cool underground catfish yokai.

notes.title: Update notes for July 4th Update: Patriotic Hotfix 2.0.1.5
notes.content:
Hi! Welcome to the fabulous world of patch 2.0.1.5, in which all of our dreams and wishes will be fulfilled*. In this patch we fix a couple of visual issues and a bug that caused crashes at the high score screen.

Upcoming real soon to Teatime Samurai: Weapons and buffs! Stay tuned! 



*Dreams and wishes may not be fulfilled
